description: This file defines an Angular service 'AuthService' that manages client-side authentication state, including login, logout, token management, and storage hydration. It interacts with HTTP endpoints and handles SSR safety.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Angular service managing authentication state, including login, logout, token persistence, and SSR safety.

methods.name: login$
methods.description: Performs login via HTTP POST, normalizes response, or falls back to demo login, then sets session.

methods.name: ensureHydrated$
methods.description: Ensures auth state hydration from storage.

methods.name: buildAuthUrl
methods.description: Constructs full URL for auth API endpoints.

methods.name: normalizeLoginResponse
methods.description: Normalizes server response into LoginResult, extracting token and user info.

methods.name: demoLogin
methods.description: Creates a demo login result with placeholder token and user info.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Updates state and persists session data.

methods.name: hydrateFromStorage
methods.description: Loads auth state from localStorage if in browser environment.

methods.name: persistToStorage
methods.description: Saves current auth state to localStorage.

methods.name: simpleHash
methods.description: Generates a non-cryptographic hash for demo IDs.
